description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!   
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.   
 Job Description: 
 Parsons is seeking a technically oriented AI DevOps Engineer to support a small software development team building and deploying a mission command software system in laboratory and field environments.

 The AI DevOps Engineer will work with senior engineers to use AI coding agents to develop, test, review, integrate, and deliver production software. The engineer will be responsible for reviewing and validating the quality of software produced with AI-assisted development tools before it is submitted for integration or merge.

 This position requires an engineer who is willing to become deeply involved in software development, systems integration, DevOps, deployment, experimentation, demonstrations, and field support. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and operation of complex technology systems, including AI-assisted software, AI agent workflows, automated build and deployment pipelines, containerized applications, security-hardened environments, and interfaces to external systems.

 What You’ll Be Doing: 
 Use AI coding agents to build, test, and review production software; provide clear requirements, context, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
 Coordinate multiple AI agents using established team workflows and contribute to improving AI-enabled development practices.
 Configure and maintain AI-assisted coding environments, tools, frameworks, and integrations with approved repositories and testing systems.
 Review and test AI-assisted software for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance with development standards; identify defects and integration risks.
 Deliver assigned user stories and technical tasks within short development sprints and against defined success criteria.
 Build and integrate software services, user interfaces, APIs, and external-system interfaces using approved data standards and exchange mechanisms.
 Maintain automated build, test, and release pipelines, and support testing and deployment in Linux-based, containerized, and security-hardened environments.
 Support data modeling, software architecture, and system integration activities.
 Document software, configurations, interfaces, deployments, and AI development tools, including their limitations and operational considerations.
 Support system installations, demonstrations, exercises, and evaluations; troubleshoot technical issues and collaborate with government, customer, industry, and partner organizations.
  
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related professional experience or additional years of directly related experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
 Must have an active Secret clearance.
 Must have a valid US Passport.
 Experience using AI models or AI coding assistants in software development.
 Working knowledge of AI frameworks and agentic frameworks.
 Experience setting up and maintaining software development or coding environments.
 Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.
 Experience with Linux, containers, source control, and automated build and deployment pipelines.
 Ability to work effectively with senior engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
 Ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
 Travel of up to 35% is anticipated. CONUS and OCONUS travel may be required.
  
   Desired Qualifications: 
 Experience orchestrating multiple AI agents on a shared body of work.
 Experience building or configuring AI agents that use tools to complete multistep tasks.
 Experience hosting and operating AI models locally or in disconnected environments.
 Experience integrating systems through application programming interfaces, message formats, data standards, and other interface mechanisms.
 Experience with container orchestration and secure software deployment.
 Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
 Experience with automated software testing.
 Experience with security hardening of software and deployment environments.
 Experience with military systems, mission command systems, defense applications, or related operational environments.
 Prior military service.
 Department of Defense 8140 baseline certification, such as Security+.
 Experience supporting laboratory, field, exercise, demonstration, or operational test events.
  
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​ 
 
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team. 
 
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now. 
 
Salary Range: $88,400.00 - $154,700.00 
 
 
 
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! 
 
 
 
This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled. 
 
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. 
 
We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! 
 Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to   https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/ .
